description: This file contains a class 'UpdateCatalogItemEndpoint' which defines a minimal API endpoint to update catalog items in an e-commerce web application. It includes route setup, authorization, and request handling logic for updating catalog item details.

classes.name: UpdateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: Defines a minimal API endpoint for updating catalog items, including route configuration and request handling.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the HTTP PUT route for updating catalog items, including authorization and request handler.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Processes the update request: fetches existing item, updates its details, and returns the result.
